title: Well-posedness, Regularity, and Strong Approximations of Superlinear Stochastic Reaction-Diffusion Equation
summary: This paper develops a general framework for the well-posedness, regularity, and strong approximation of the stochastic reaction--diffusion equation (SRDE) with superlinear drift and diffusion coefficients. We first extend the well-posedness results in \emph{W. Liu and M. Röckner, J. Funct. Anal., 2902--2922, 2010} and \emph{W. Liu, J. Differential Equations, 572--592, 2013} to the case of superlinear diffusion in the Gelfand triple \(V \hookrightarrow H \hookrightarrow V^*\), with \(V\) equipped with the norm \(\|\cdot\|_V\), and derive a moment estimate by establishing a new Itô formula for…
